notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Call 911 now, or have someone take you straight to an emergency department immediately — do not drive yourself. A new bad headache and repeated vomiting the day after hitting your head, while on warfarin, can signal bleeding around the brain that needs urgent scanning and blood tests. If you become drowsy, confused, weak, or have trouble speaking while waiting, that makes calling 911 even more urgent.
